scope: Published build facts and original local summaries; full source articles are linked, not mirrored.

selection.weapons: First three recommendations per general or specialist section, retaining listed weapon Potential.
selection.gear: First two published loadouts with complete four-slot equipment lists.
selection.skills: Published skill investment orders by role. These are upgrade priorities, not combat input sequences.
selection.stats: No independent ranked stat priority is inferred from item names or generic commentary.
